extraction.title: Advanced SQL Analytics Framework
extraction.head: advanced-sql-analytics

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as replacing the external DuckDB dependency with an internal SQL engine: a new pkg/expr/sql/db.go DB struct, sql_command.go and parser.go switched to sql.NewInMemoryDB(), a enableSqlExpressions() feature flag in reader.go, and go.mod/go.work.sum cleanup. Warns that every new DB method returns "not implemented", so SQL expressions would be non-functional. Confidence score 0/5.
TablesList now calls a stub that always returns a 'not implemented' error, breaking SQL parsing.
Duplicate of the same comment: TablesList now calls a stub that always returns a 'not implemented' error, breaking SQL parsing.
QueryFramesInto is called directly by SQLCommand.Execute() but always fails, breaking SQL expressions when the feature is enabled. Suggests the stub is a blocker.
Logic error: the double negation on the IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions) result makes enabled true when the flag is off. Suggested change: drop the leading negation.
The enableSqlExpressions() check always returns false regardless of flag state. If disabling is intentional, it should be documented. Suggested change: return true when enabled.
The json_serialize_sql call is DuckDB-specific and will not work with the stub implementation.
TablesList is called by sql.TablesList() in parser.go but always fails, preventing SQL query validation.
Notice that the Greptile free trial has ended.
